steps.title: Bem-vindo: Daily Life - Volume 35
steps.text: In this C1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Daily Life". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I always procrastinate on Sunday nights.
I finally got used to waking up early.
I didn't hear my alarm clock this morning.

steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "First Conditional"?
options: If I were you, I would study more.

steps.title: Idiom: Under the weather
steps.text: It means: "Feeling slightly ill.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today.
